cards.title: Meta Releases Muse Ember Lightweight AI Model
cards.body: Meta launched Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution priced at 10 cents per million input tokens. It significantly undercuts frontier competitors like Haiku and Luna on cost.

cards.title: Anthropic Invests $3.4B in Natural Gas Turbines
cards.body: Anthropic purchased billions in natural gas turbines to power AI infrastructure. The massive energy commitment reflects the sector's escalating compute demands.

cards.title: Medium Launches TK App With AI Writing Assistance
cards.body: Medium introduced a new writing app integrating AI assistance directly into the creation process. The move comes amid ongoing debate about AI's role in publishing.

cards.title: Automattic Debuts Spacefast Platform for App Deployment
cards.body: Automattic launched Spacefast to compete with platforms like Lovable for vibe-coding app deployment. The platform addresses evolving internet development needs.

cards.title: Nvidia Board Investigates CEO Jensen Huang Affair
cards.body: Nvidia's board launched an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's acknowledged affair with a suspected Chinese spy. The scandal threatens the company's China lobbying efforts and export restriction negotiations.

cards.title: Yale Expert Assesses Huang's 50-50 CEO Survival Odds
cards.body: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld estimates Jensen Huang has roughly a coin-flip chance of remaining Nvidia CEO amid the investigation. Board scrutiny intensifies over his relationship with alleged Chinese intelligence asset.

cards.title: Megaspeed Executive Allegedly Recruited to Spy Nvidia
cards.body: A U.S. intelligence memo reportedly detailed China's Ministry of State Security recruiting a female tech executive to spy on Nvidia's CEO. The operation highlights geopolitical tensions around AI leadership.

cards.title: Crusoe Sells Wyoming Data Center Project to Google
cards.body: Crusoe offloaded its troubled Wyoming data center project to Google in a high-profile asset sale. The deal underscores persistent challenges in massive AI infrastructure development.

cards.title: OpenAI Raises Additional $11B at $1.25T Valuation
cards.body: OpenAI secured an additional $11 billion in funding as part of an ongoing round expected to close soon. The raise values the company at $1.25 trillion.

cards.title: Hundreds of Artex AI Hacking Tools Publicly Exposed
cards.body: Security researchers discovered hundreds of servers hosting Artex penetration testing tools exposed to the internet. The exposure granted unrestricted public access to advanced hacking capabilities.

cards.title: Meta Introduces Spaces for Muse Agent Collaboration
cards.body: Meta unveiled Spaces, a new feature enabling collaborative interaction with Muse AI agents. The capability expands Muse's functionality and integration options.

cards.title: Voters Restrict Data Center Development in Midterms
cards.body: In Tuesday's U.S. midterm elections, voters passed 40 of 41 ballot measures restricting data center development. The results signal major regulatory headwinds for AI infrastructure expansion.

cards.title: Ramp Data Shows AI Spending Stalling Despite Growth
cards.body: Ramp's spending data reveals AI usage continues climbing while actual expenditures have plateaued. Price cuts and cost controls among major spenders could challenge hypergrowth investor expectations.

cards.title: Amazon Enables Text-Based Alexa Shopping Assistant
cards.body: Amazon rolled out text-to-Alexa functionality for shopping assistance to millions of users. The feature expands Alexa's capabilities after earlier Meta Muse integration disputes.

cards.title: Underdog Demonstrates Compact 32MB Speech Model
cards.body: Underdog showcased a remarkably compact 32MB speech model capable of generating both speech and music. The breakthrough demonstrates efficient model architecture despite minimal size.

cards.title: Physicl Raises $10M to Bridge Sim-to-Real Gap
cards.body: Physicl secured $10 million to address the sim-to-real problem for robotic systems using adapted online commerce technology. The pipeline enables robots to better transition from simulation to physical environments.

cards.title: Nancy Pelosi's replacement ready to regulate AI
cards.body: Scott Wiener, a California state senator who authored AI risk legislation, won Nancy Pelosi's former San Francisco congressional seat. He is now positioned to play a key role in shaping federal AI policy.

cards.title: Empty AI climate claims under investigation
cards.body: As countries meet at the UN climate conference, the climate case for AI remains unproven. Experts argue that AI's environmental benefits have not been substantiated.

cards.title: AI innovation in specialty chemicals industry
cards.body: Companies are accelerating innovation using AI, cloud computing, and advanced modeling in specialty chemicals. The primary challenge is connecting new technologies to reliable data and scientific expertise.

cards.title: Claude Code accidentally exposing secrets on GitHub
cards.body: Claude Code is unintentionally leaking sensitive information across GitHub repositories. This security vulnerability poses risks to developers and organizations using the AI coding assistant.

cards.title: Humanoid robot cleaning service launches in San Francisco
cards.body: A new humanoid robot cleaning service is operating in San Francisco, offering a glimpse into AI-powered household automation. The service demonstrates practical applications of robotics in everyday tasks.

cards.title: Texas AI data center boom faces uncertainty
cards.body: Texas, the fastest-growing data center market and epicenter of Big Tech's AI buildouts, may face challenges after recent political shifts. Energy policy changes could impact the state's AI infrastructure expansion.
